description: [read-only] Read content. mode="list" returns one page of summaries (limit, cursor, fields); mode="get" requires id and returns the full item. Use only the chosen mode's arguments. Full mode definitions: describe_tool {"name":"list_content"} or {"name":"get_content"}. Legacy names list_content and get_content remain callable.

brandId.description: Format: string; e.g. "brandId_123". A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Omitted: the key's brand (brand-bound key) or the owner's active brand.

cursor.description: Opaque string, e.g. "eyJvIjoyMH0". The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: String array, e.g. ["id", "title"]. Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default summary: id, contentId, displayTitle, title, type, durationMs, createdAt, postState. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

id.description: Format: string; e.g. "id_123". Record identifier returned by the corresponding list or create tool; use a real ID.

includeArchived.description: Format: boolean; e.g. false. Whether to include archived items.

limit.description: Integer, e.g. 20. Items per page (1-50, default 20).

mode.description: String mode, e.g. "list". list returns paged summaries; get returns one full item and requires id.

name: read_content
title: Read content
